description: This file defines the 'ClusterSingletonSupervisorActor' class, an Akka actor responsible for supervising singleton actors within a cluster that applies specific supervision strategies for exception handling and actor lifecycle management.

classes.name: ClusterSingletonSupervisorActor
classes.description: A supervisor actor for managing cluster singleton actors with custom supervision strategies.

methods.name: buildDefaultSupervisorStrategy
methods.description: Creates the default supervision strategy with specific exception handling and restart/stop directives.

methods.name: restartChild
methods.description: Logs the restart action and returns the directive to restart the child actor.

methods.name: terminateActorSystem
methods.description: Logs the termination and shuts down the actor system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props with only child props.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Overloaded static factory method to create Props with child props and a supervision strategy.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervisor strategy associated with this actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling by forwarding all messages to the child actor.
